comments.quote: 房間設施齊全完善，乾淨整潔。老闆娘服務周到熱情，農家菜燒的非常好吃，房間安靜舒適，周邊有步道小溪。離魚鱗壩，龍鱗壩多非常近。非常滿意。
comments.author: Gugongqin
comments.quoteEn: The room has everything and is clean and tidy. She looks after guests well and her country cooking is very good. Quiet, comfortable rooms, with a footpath and a stream nearby. Very close to both the fish scale and the Longlin weirs. Thoroughly satisfied.
